evidence.observation: Pressure 2.90 Torr at start of growth, matching the ~2.93-2.96 Torr seen through the ramp at 100 sccm
Pressure has risen every reading to 3.224 Torr (~+0.32 Torr in 600 s), and the rise is speeding up
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by the inflow
Thermocouple steady at 750 °C with heater power ~46%, so temperature control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so we can't check whether air is getting into the tube

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or a leak-up/rate-of-rise test with the gas inlet closed) would separate an air leak through a seal from an exhaust/pump-line blockage. A pump-side pressure reading or a check of the exhaust line conductance would also help.
